description: Complementary two-sender messages to one receiver, with single-sender and redundant-view controls

population.team_format: dual tuple is receiver, food_sender, water_sender; single tuple is receiver, sender
population.schedule: each update uses four teams so every agent is receiver once and sender in both dual roles once

views.food_only: only the food slot and its existence bit are visible in both frames
views.water_only: only the water slot and its existence bit are visible in both frames
views.dual_complementary: food sender receives food_only and water sender receives water_only

limitations: The four population members reuse two frozen private encoders and a fixed four-team schedule.
The complementary views are deterministic masks of the frozen two-frame visual input, not human perceptual development.
The task is a controlled two-resource protocol; one token per sender tests component exchange, not a full human language.
The receiver sees only two ordered discrete messages and no visual state.
